Connecting readers discovering stories with creators publishing them.
독자는 작품을 탐색하고 감상하며, 작가는 작품과 회차를 등록·관리하는 웹: A webtoon publishing platform where readers discover and read titles, and creators publish and manage titles and episodes. I joined at the MVP stage, focusing on manuscript editing, the mobile feed, and shared data fetching.
담당 기능 프론트엔드 단독 개발: Sole frontend developer for the assigned features
오늘의웹툰 PC 화면. 작품 카드와 장르별 목록을 탐색하는 웹툰 플랫폼: Webtoon Today desktop interface with title cards and lists organized by genre. Original interface in Korean.
이미지·ZIP 업로드에서 미리보기, 규격 변환, 모바일 순서 편집까지 연: Connected image and ZIP uploads with previews, image resizing and cropping, and reordering on mobile
모바일 피드의 카드 스냅, 앱 내 위치 복원과 추가 조회 구현: Implemented card snapping, in-app position restoration, and incremental fetching for the mobile feed
작품·작가·회차를 공유하는 Recoil 조회·갱신 구조 구성: Built shared fetching and refresh flows for titles, creators, and episodes using Recoil
Distinguishing selected files from files ready to submit.
파일을 읽는 시점과 서버 업로드가 끝나는 시점은 다릅니다. 사용자는 파일: Reading a file and completing its upload are separate events. Users needed to review and reorder files after adding them, while the final submission needed to include the URLs of completed uploads in the edited order.
FileReader로 로컬 미리보기를 먼저 표시한 뒤 발급받은 업로드 U: I first displayed local previews with FileReader, then sent files to the issued upload URLs. Once each remote image loaded, I replaced its preview URL with the server URL and updated its loading indicator. For ZIP files, I added the image list returned by the server-side extraction API to the editing data.
용도에 맞는 이미지 처리: Image processing tailored to each use case
홍보 이미지는 원본·목표 종횡비로 중앙 크롭 영역을 계산해 Canvas에: For promotional images, I calculated a centered crop from the original and target aspect ratios and used Canvas to produce a 600×600 image. For individual thumbnails that required user-selected crops, I integrated react-cropper.
마우스와 터치에서 순서 편집: Reordering with mouse and touch input
마우스는 드래그 대상과 현재 요소의 위치를 비교하고, 터치는 이미지 중심: For mouse input, I compared the positions of the dragged item and the current element. For touch input, I calculated the destination index from image centers, cell dimensions, and the number of columns. I distinguished external file drops from internal reordering and restricted out-of-bounds moves and reordering during uploads.
파일 추가부터 미리보기·규격 변환·순서 편집을 거쳐 접수 데이터로 전달하: I built the flow from adding files through previews, image transformation, and reordering to submission data. Upload logic was shared through a common function, while single-image, filename-list, and grid views were separate components reused across publishing and application screens.
다시 설계한다면 안정적인 파일 ID와 파일별 실패·취소·재시도 상태를 명: In a redesign, I would define stable file IDs and explicit per-file failure, cancellation, and retry states. I would prioritize checking that edited items match submission data even when asynchronous operations finish out of order.
Keeping browsing continuous when users return from a detail page.
PC에서는 여러 작품을 비교하고, 모바일에서는 한 작품에 집중하는 탐색이: Desktop users needed to compare multiple titles, while mobile users needed to focus on one title at a time. On mobile, the feed needed to snap to a card when a gesture ended and resume at the previous title when users returned from a detail page.
바깥 피드의 이동 규칙을 직접 구현: Implementing navigation rules for the outer feed
시작·이동·종료 좌표와 이전 translateY를 추적했습니다. 카드 높: I tracked start, move, and end coordinates along with the previous translateY value. I calculated the destination index using card height, margins, direction, and a threshold, then used CSS transforms and transitions to snap into place. Wheel input had a short cooldown.
상태의 수명에 따른 저장 위치: Choosing where to store state based on its lifetime
마지막 작품 키는 Recoil, 현재 포커스는 React state, 드: I stored the last title key in Recoil, the current focus in React state, and dragging status and coordinates in refs. On returning to the feed within the app, I located the saved title key and calculated its position. This was in-app restoration, not persistent storage across browser sessions.
라이브러리와 직접 구현의 경계: Defining the boundary between library and custom behavior
카드 내부 이미지 페이드·자동 재생은 Swiper가 담당합니다. 재생 완: Swiper handled image fades and autoplay within each card. I connected its playback completion callback to the outer feed's next-card navigation and requested more data when users approached the last few cards after a transition. Desktop views provided tab-specific lists with 12 more items per load.
PC의 목록 탐색과 모바일의 카드 탐색이 공통 데이터를 활용하도록 구성했: I enabled desktop list browsing and mobile card browsing to use shared data, connecting swiping, card snapping, return navigation, and fetching more data into a continuous flow.
직접 제어하는 만큼 카드 크기·경계 인덱스·타이머 정리도 직접 관리해야: Custom control also means managing card dimensions, index boundaries, and timer cleanup. Next, I would extract destination-index calculation into a standalone function and prioritize cases where a saved title is missing or new input arrives during an animation.
Separating page-specific lists from shared title data.
피드·검색·상세 화면은 같은 작품 정보를 서로 다른 목록과 UI에서 사용: Feed, search, and detail pages use the same title information in different lists and interfaces. Storing each page's responses separately could scatter data composition and update logic, so I established shared data and fetching paths.
작품·작가·회차의 조회 키 목록과 데이터 객체 맵을 Recoil에서 관리: I managed query-key lists and data object maps for titles, creators, and episodes in Recoil. Feed and search results held title keys, which were combined with shared object maps to produce rendering data.
secureFetch는 기존 키를 걸러 필요한 데이터만 요청하고, 작품: secureFetch filtered out existing keys to request only the data needed, batching multiple title keys into a single API request. refreshTitle, refreshUser, and episode refresh functions provided explicit paths to refetch existing data as well.
등록·신청까지 연결: Extending the flow to publishing and applications
세션과 작품 소유 정보로 감상·관리 UI를 분기했습니다. 접수 폼에서 인: I used session and title ownership information to distinguish reading and management interfaces. Application forms validated authentication, required fields, and upload status, then called the title, episode, content, and application APIs in sequence, reporting failures at each step.
각 화면이 공통 작품·작가 데이터를 재사용하고 공통 훅으로 조회·갱신 흐: Each page reused shared title and creator data and accessed fetching and refresh flows through common hooks. Focus, loading, and editing state remained local.
키를 이용한 메모리 내 재사용 구조이므로 캐시 유효성과 실패 요청의 재조: This key-based, in-memory reuse approach leaves cache validity and retry policies to the application. In a redesign, I would separate request state from successfully cached data and define retry and invalidation policies explicitly.
Turning performance data into reports customers can interpret.
웹툰 작품의 순위·매출·독자와 마케팅 성과를 확인하는 B2B 서비스입니다: A B2B service for tracking webtoon rankings, revenue, readership, and marketing performance. I implemented API integration for customer reports, metric-specific custom charts, paid-report states, and a customer demonstration environment.
웹툰 메트릭 데모 화면. 작품과 광고 지표를 요약 수치와 차트로 비교하는: Webtoon Metric demo dashboard comparing title and advertising metrics through summary figures and charts. Original interface in Korean.
D3 계산과 React SVG 렌더링을 분리한 공통 차트 구성: Built shared charts with D3 calculations separated from React SVG rendering
작품·장르 평균 비교와 지표별 단위·요약 설명 연결: Connected title-to-genre-average comparisons with metric-specific units and summaries
기존 화면과 요청 구조를 재사용하는 고객 시연용 데모 구현: Built a customer demo that reused existing screens and request structures
Reusing charts while preserving each metric's meaning.
내부 운영 중심의 데이터를 고객이 비교·해석할 수 있는 리포트로 구성해야: Data used primarily for internal operations needed to become reports customers could compare and interpret. Smaller ranking numbers needed to appear higher, while title revenue and the genre average needed to share a chart. This required fine-grained control over axes, grids, labels, and previews.
RankChart·SalesChart에서 응답을 { date, value: RankChart and SalesChart converted responses into arrays of { date, value } objects. Rankings used one series; revenue used two for the title and genre average. These were passed to a shared MultiLineChart with the appropriate units, legends, and summaries.
D3는 계산, React는 렌더링: D3 for calculations, React for rendering
D3의 extent·scaleLinear·scaleTime·line·ar: I used D3's extent, scaleLinear, scaleTime, line, and area functions to calculate domains, ticks, coordinates, and paths, then rendered path, line, text, and circle elements in React JSX. Tooltip guide lines, markers, and HTML positions were also calculated from data coordinates.
순위의 Y축을 반전하고 날짜·숫자 축을 구분했습니다. 축·격자 표시, 여: I inverted the Y-axis for rankings and distinguished date and numeric axes. Configurable axes, grids, margins, colors, and area fills allowed the shared chart to accommodate each metric's presentation requirements.
순위와 매출이 같은 선형 차트 컴포넌트를 재사용하도록 구성했습니다. 고객: Rankings and revenue reused the same line-chart component. The reports allowed customers to read trends alongside the relevant comparison baseline.
표현을 직접 제어하는 만큼 빈 데이터·좁은 값 범위·눈금·툴팁 좌표 같은: Direct control over presentation also requires handling edge cases such as empty data, narrow value ranges, ticks, and tooltip positions. I focused shared functionality on presentation needs actually used across multiple metrics.
Changing the response path while keeping the same screens.
고객 시연에서는 기존 서비스 화면을 유지하면서 시연용 데이터를 보여줘야: Customer demonstrations needed to show demo data within the existing service interface. I introduced a switching point at the shared Axios request boundary to change the response path for requests covered by demo mode.
데모 진입 시 모드 설정과 세션 갱신을 연결했습니다. request in: Entering the demo connected mode configuration with session refresh. A request interceptor checked the demo flag and endpoint, then attached a custom adapter to applicable requests.
URL 경로에 맞는 mock handler를 선택해 기존 API와 호환되: I selected mock handlers based on URL paths to return responses compatible with the existing API. Features unavailable in the demo were handled with explanatory messages and error responses.
화면별 시연용 UI를 별도로 만들지 않고 기존 컴포넌트와 API 호출 구: I reused existing components and API call structures without building separate demo interfaces for each screen. The resulting environment supported customer demonstrations and follow-up consultations.
API 응답 형식이나 지원 기능이 바뀌면 mock handler도 함께: Mock handlers need to be maintained as API response formats and supported features change. Sharing the UI does not remove the need to maintain demo responses and the scope of request switching.
Separating purchase status from data readiness.
구매 전에는 리포트 구성을 보여주되 상세 수치를 제한하고, 생성 중에는: Before purchase, users needed to see the report structure with detailed figures restricted. During generation, data that was not ready needed to remain hidden. I retained the overall layout while showing data and guidance appropriate to each state.
I masked detailed figures and displayed preview charts and purchase guidance.
리포트 생성 중임을 안내하고 준비되지 않은 상세 데이터의 표시를 제한했습: I indicated that the report was being generated and restricted the display of detailed data that was not ready.
준비된 상세 수치와 분석 차트를 표시했습니다. 데이터가 없는 차트에는 별: I displayed the available detailed figures and analysis charts, with separate preview presentations for charts without data.
서버가 제공한 상태와 데이터에 따라 사용자가 볼 수 있는 정보와 안내를: I configured visible information and guidance based on server-provided states and data. Authorization for paid data and payment processing remained server responsibilities.
Toast·Loading·Drawer를 공통 컴포넌트와 Hook으로 구축: I built shared Toast, Loading, and Drawer components and hooks used across three services. I managed the stacking order of nested drawers and Escape handling to close the topmost drawer.
한글 초성·불완전 음절 검색과 미조회 작품 일괄 요청을 구현했습니다. 분: I implemented search supporting Korean initial consonants and partially composed syllables, along with batch requests for titles not yet fetched. I reorganized analytics into reach, views, engagement, and reader characteristics, and visualized them with charts.
JSON 기반 스토리·대사·캐릭터 연출과 주요 클라이언트 기능을 구현했습: I implemented JSON-driven story, dialogue, character presentation, and core client features. I handled device testing, App Store and Google Play review requirements, and the release process.
PR 리뷰와 인턴 개발자의 온보딩 문서·초기 과제·코드 리뷰를 지원했습니: I supported PR reviews and intern onboarding through documentation, initial assignments, and code reviews. I analyzed user behavior events and operational logs to investigate service errors and customer inquiries.
공개 플랫폼과 공모전·분석 신청 흐름을 구축해 분석 작품 수 확대에 기여: I helped expand the number of titles analyzed by building the public platform and application flows for contests and analysis services.
내부 집계 기준 약 100개 → 약 1,000개. 개인 구현만의 성과로: Approximately 100 to 1,000 titles, based on internal counts. This growth is not attributable solely to my implementation work.
